{{Short description|Statistical regions of Spain}}
{{main article|Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics}}
{{Politics of Spain}}
In the '''NUTS''' (Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics) codes of '''[[Spain]]''' (ES), the following are the first-level [[political divisions of Spain|political and administrative divisions]].

== Overall ==

=== NUTS Codes ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Level
! Subdivisions
! #
|-
! [[First level NUTS of the European Union#Spain|NUTS 1]]
| Groups of autonomous communities (''Agrupación de comunidades autónomas'')
| align="right" | 7
|-
! NUTS 2
| [[Autonomous communities of Spain|Autonomous communities and cities]] (''Comunidades y ciudades autónomas'')
| align="right" | 19
|-
! NUTS 3
| [[Provinces of Spain|Provinces]] + [[List of islands of Spain|Islands]] + [[Ceuta]] and [[Melilla]] (''Provincias + islas + Ceuta y Melilla'')
| align="right" | 59
|}

===Local administrative units===
{{main article|Local administrative unit}}

Below the NUTS levels, the two LAU (Local Administrative Units) levels are:

{| class="wikitable"
! Level
! Subdivisions
! #
|-
! LAU 1
| — (same as NUTS 3)
| align="right" | 59
|-
! LAU 2
| [[Municipalities of Spain|Municipalities]] (''Municipios'')
| align="right" | 8114
|}

''The LAU codes of Spain can be downloaded here:'' {{XLSlink|[http://epp.eurostat.ec.europa.eu/portal/page/portal/nuts_nomenclature/documents/ES-LAU.xls]}}
